scope: 2026-06 through 2026-08 ordinary-chat agent execution, routing, MCP, browser, reliability, and observability

sources.evidence: Aug 2026 commits include agent-server telemetry, Activity Log/run-cost export, MCP credential preservation, skills UI, and automation interface improvements.
adopted: execution evidence must be exported
runtime state and credentials are separate concerns
agent UX should expose run state rather than hide it

sources.evidence: 2026-07-28 stable protocol line uses modern server/discover behavior and per-response server identity metadata; migration guidance changes connection semantics.
adopted: real client integration tests
explicit protocol target
transport interruption must fail closed
capability discovery is a runtime concern

sources.evidence: Toolsets and tool_choice support dynamically constraining available capabilities instead of loading every tool for every request.
adopted: smallest sufficient tool surface
task-specific capability restriction
do not expose universal shell as a convenience tool

sources.evidence: Playwright CLI supports agent skills installation and CLI-first snapshots for coding agents.
adopted: CLI+Skill for deterministic browser work
MCP only when persistent interactive state adds value
generated browser state must not dirty the agent repository

sources.evidence: Aug 2026 fixes/issues emphasize long-session state correctness, async callback handling, resource cleanup, storage-state correctness, and false-success browser actions.
adopted: false-success is a first-class failure mode
long-running browser sessions need explicit liveness/resource checks
adaptive browser backend remains optional and independently health-checked

sources.evidence: Jul-Aug 2026 work includes MCP 2.0 migration, timeout bounding for background agents, durable-task separation, orphan approval prevention, and workflow routing metadata.
adopted: background work must be bounded
routing metadata must be visible
orphan state is tested as a failure mode
durability is separated from orchestration

sources.evidence: Current guardrail and tracing docs distinguish workflow boundaries, tool-level validation, recoverable tool-not-found behavior, and end-to-end traces.
adopted: validate at tool/relay boundary
make failures recoverable without pretending success
trace exact run identity and completion evidence

v4Synthesis: GitHub Actions can be an ordinary-chat cloud execution relay when requests are declarative and execution is fixed/allowlisted.
Immediate usability must be proven by multiple independent evidence channels, not CI green alone.
A local device is an optional high-power backend, not a prerequisite for the ordinary-chat GitHub path.
Ten independent lanes are used as verification workers; five orthogonal completion methods form the final gate.
Artifacts, hashes, run SHA, workflow run id, and lane evidence are part of the product surface, not debugging leftovers.
